title: UAV-EHFS: code and outputs for task-aware elbow feature selection on UAV-NIDD
description: Code and outputs for the UAV-EHFS study (PLOS ONE manuscript PONE-D-26-48338, revision 1): the pipeline (uav_ehfs.py), the feature audit of UAV-NIDD and the analyses added in revision 1 (review/), all result files with per-fold cross-validation curves, confusion matrices and test-set predictions, and the scripts that generate every table, in-text number and figure of the manuscript. review/run_revision.sh lists every command in the order it was run.
